subject: houndeye
label: houndeye, in the place of the game's models/houndeye.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/barney.mdl, models/hassassin.mdl, models/scientist.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, D, B where the asset was C, A, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The brief asks for a squat body on three thin legs. In sides.png the outline has four or more leg tubes, not three: the FRONT view shows a left leg, a right leg and an angled leg at the right edge, and the LEFT view shows two vertical and two angled legs. The body reads as a round sphere with a fleshy lower lobe under the head, which the brief does not mention. The silhouette is spider-like, not the brief's squat three-legged form. Height (44.6 against 45) and length (53.1 against 49) are close.

M2.reason: Measured size is 53.1 x 44.6 x 46.5 units. The brief gives about 45 tall and 49 long. Height is within 1% and length is 8.3% over, inside the 15% line (sizeOff 0.083).

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, checked one by one: the large eye on the front is present (red, on the front lobe, FRONT and FRONT-LEFT views). The body is present. The three thin legs are not right: sides.png shows four or more leg tubes (FRONT, LEFT, BACK and TOP views), so the count is wrong and M3 is capped at 1. The striped hide is present as paint (see M5). The leg ends are plain stubs with no claws or feet, which the brief does not ask for.

M4.reason: The body is yellow, as the brief asks, with a darker shaded underside in BELOW. The eye is a dark red, which the brief does not specify and does not contradict. Skin-like matte material on the body and legs. No region reads as a wrong colour or material.

M5.reason: The stripes are there: dark slits across the top and sides in TOP, LEFT and RIGHT, in their places. The dappling is thin: only a handful of small dark dots on the top and side, not an overall dappled hide as the brief asks. The brief's 'dappled' is under-delivered.

M6.reason: Capped by the line-up test, as instructed. In the lineup.png line-up the asset (B in this picture) is a yellow creature beside three human figures, and it is recognisable as the odd one out at that scale. Measured: the asset was identified as the non-Valve model once in three readings (judges picked B, D, B where the asset was C, A, B), which is under the 'twice or more' line, so M6 is not capped below 2.

M7.reason: The eye is on the front, as the FRONT and LEFT views show. The body stands upright on its legs at floor level in FRONT, LEFT and RIGHT, with no lying or tipping. The brief does not give a facing beyond the eye.

M8.reason: SMAK's check passes (checkErrors is empty). 472 triangles against a cap of 1,152 (twice Half-Life's median of 576; three quarters of its kind are under 740, so the larger bound is 1,152). Nothing reported open or inside out. The leg stubs appear to meet the body in the side views.

C1.reason: In motion (motion.png, frames 0 to 36 of a run, floor a line): the body stays whole and the legs stay on it, but the poses are hard to follow at this size. In RUN 21 and RUN 31 a leg end seems to hang above the floor line rather than touch it, and the legs barely change pose between several frames. The judge cannot confirm that every joint moves as Half-Life's does, so C1 is held at 1.
